description: This file manages tracking of browser session tabs, including functions to add, remove, and close tracked tabs, as well as utility functions for normalization and testing.

methods.name: normalizeSessionKey
methods.description: Normalizes session key by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeProfile
methods.description: Normalizes profile string by trimming and converting to lowercase, or returns undefined if input is undefined or empty.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes base URL by trimming, or returns undefined if input is undefined or empty.

methods.name: toTrackedTabId
methods.description: Creates a unique string identifier for a tracked tab based on targetId, baseUrl, and profile.

methods.name: isIgnorableCloseError
methods.description: Determines if an error message indicates a close tab error that can be ignored.

methods.name: takeTrackedTabsForSessionKeys
methods.description: Retrieves and removes tracked tabs for given session keys.
